speaker: 员工一
cn: （目瞪口呆）不愧是组长，一分钟不到就解决了这么大的危机！
en: (Stunned) That’s our team lead! He handled a crisis this big in under a minute!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （尖声）这怎么可能？你这个废物竟然破解的了病毒？
en: (尖叫) How is this possible? A useless piece of trash like you has actually cracked the virus!

speaker: Damián
cn: （轻松）这些黑客利用的是Eloísa的数据漏洞，修改了注册表，其实不算特别高明。
en: (casually) They just exploited a vulnerability in Eloísa’s code and modified the registry. Nothing too sophisticated.

speaker: Damián
cn: 现在，谁是废物？
en: Now, who did you call useless?

speaker: Isadora
cn: （震惊）你说他一个人一分钟就搞定了？
en: (Shocked) You’re telling me he fixed the whole thing by himself in under a minute?

speaker: Mirella
cn: （笑着点头）对啊，总裁，你这回可是捡到宝了！
en: (smiling and nodding) Exactly, CEO—this time you've really struck gold!

speaker: Isadora
cn: 今晚给他举办个欢迎会吧，多批点钱。还有，他的奖金也增加！
en: Throw him a welcome party tonight. Spare no expense. And bump up his bonus, too!

speaker: Mirella
cn: （点头）好的。
en: (nodding) Okay.

speaker: 戒指（OS）
cn: （低沉，带回声）命运节点已记录。节点：Bar（酒吧）。命运馈赠——神秘药剂，饮者可令心仪之人为你倾心。
en: (deep, echoing) Fate-node recorded. Node: Bar. Fate's offering—the Mystic Elixir; whoever drinks it shall win the heart of the one they desire.

speaker: Damián(VO)
cn: （咋舌）这个能力……算了，试试吧。
en: (In disbelief) This ability... Forget it—let's try it anyway.

speaker: Damián
cn: （回味）这也没什么感觉啊，戒指逗我玩呢吧！
en: (Reflecting) Doesn't taste anything special – maybe the ring is just playing a trick on me.

speaker: 员工一
cn: Damián，过来一起跳舞啊！
en: Damián, come over and have some fun!

speaker: Damián
cn: （起身）来了！
en: (stands up) Coming!

speaker: Eloísa(VO)
cn: 只要让Damián想起我的好，肯定还会对我言听计从的！
en: Once Damián remembers how good I was to him, he’ll be wrapped around my finger again!

speaker: Eloísa(VO)
cn: （得意）成了！
en: (Proudly) Got you!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （假惺惺）Damián？Damián？你是不是喝多了？我送你回去吧！
en: (acting apologetic) Damián? Damián? Have you had too much to drink? Let me take you home.

speaker: Damián
cn: （迷糊）Eloísa？你别碰我……
en: (confused) Eloísa? Don't touch me!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: 虽然你不如Julián有钱，但也算个潜力股，我确实也想你的技术了。Julián不一定会娶我，那就先便宜你吧！
en: You may not be as rich as Julián, but you’ve got potential. And I have to admit, I’ve missed your... skills. Julián might not marry me anyway, so I guess I’ll give you another chance. Lucky you.

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （震惊）总裁？你们怎么在这里？
en: (Surprised) CEO? Why are you here?

speaker: Isadora
cn: （冷声）放下他。
en: (coldly) Put him down.

speaker: Eloísa
cn: 他是我的男朋友。
en: He is my boyfriend.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （冷声）我最后说一次，让你放开！
en: (Coldly) I won't say this again—PUT HIM DOWN
